beta_notice: RunPod API v2 is beta; schema drift is treated as a first-class failure mode. The adapter refuses to operate when the live schema identity diverges from this pinned snapshot on safety-relevant surfaces (see schema_check.py).
notes: No 'interruptible'/spot field exists anywhere in the v2 schema: v2 Pods are on-demand; the adapter additionally asserts the absence of any such field so future drift that introduces one fails closed rather than silently accepting interruptible capacity.
pinned_surfaces: GET /v2/pods, POST /v2/pods (CreatePodRequest: allOf ContainerConfig + {name*, image*, cloud, gpu{id*,count}, dataCenterIds, mounts})
GET /v2/billing, GET /v2/billing/pods (podId, startTime, endTime, bucketSize, lastN)
GpuType {id*, name*, memory*, secure*, community*, price{secure*,community*}, maxCount{secure*,community*}, availability?, dataCenters?}
retrieval_method: unauthenticated HTTPS GET (read-only; no mutating request)
